row.scim_price_text: Included on paid plans; Email plan from $20/mo (500 active profiles)
row.evidence: Klaviyo's SCIM guide says "You must have a paid plan and be an Admin or Owner to set up this feature" and SSO must be on first; the cheapest paid plan is Email at $20/mo.
row.notes: Status changed gated to free: Klaviyo's offering did not change (SCIM on any paid plan, as in June), but under the v3 price-gate rule SCIM on the cheapest paid plan with no upcharge is 'free'. Pricing is by active profiles (contacts), not seats, so per-user fields and the multiplier are null; the plans view shows Free (up to 250 active profiles), Email $20/mo and Marketing $90/mo at 500 profiles (monthly; no annual price shown). The pricing page itself does not mention SSO or SCIM (gate comes from the help centre, hence medium confidence). SAML SSO (IdP-initiated only) must be enabled before SCIM. Okta and Entra are documented as custom SAML/SCIM apps; OneLogin has a Klaviyo catalogue connector with SCIM bearer token. Klaviyo's public REST API documents no user or team-member endpoints.

plans.name: Email
plans.price_text: $20/mo at 500 active profiles (price scales with profiles)

auth.token_source: Organization name > Settings > Security > SCIM Provisioning (access key with Klaviyo-API-Key prefix, shown once)

operations.notes: Okta guide enables Create Users, Update User Attributes and Deactivate Users; OneLogin guide keeps Create/Delete/Update user and recommends Delete on removal. Whether the API takes PUT or PATCH is not documented.

attributes.notes: List from the Entra section: 'Klaviyo only supports the following attributes'. Okta adds a 'role' attribute in the core 2.0 User namespace.

roles.how: role attribute (core schema) with values admin, manager, analyst, campaign_coordinator, content_creator, support; roles then become read-only in Klaviyo

limitations.text: SSO must be turned on before SCIM can be set up.
Entra: appRoleAssignments not supported; only the listed attributes are supported.
With SSO JIT/SCIM on, user roles can only be changed in the IdP.

user_api.notes: developers.klaviyo.com API reference (584 endpoint pages) lists account endpoints (Get Accounts) but no user, team-member or role endpoints; left null as no explicit statement.

okta.notes: An OIN 'Klaviyo' listing exists (SSO use case, 2016) but Klaviyo's own SSO and SCIM guides use a custom SAML app with SCIM added.

entra.notes: Klaviyo's guide uses a non-gallery 'Create your own application' app with Automatic provisioning.

onelogin.notes: Per Klaviyo's guide; OneLogin's own connector page not loaded.

open_questions: SCIM base URL pattern is not published (shown in the Klaviyo UI only).
What a SCIM deactivate does in Klaviyo (removal vs suspension, data kept) is not documented.
Group provisioning support is not documented.
No public user-management REST API found; Klaviyo does not state either way.
